title: Economic demand truth: Proxima-inspired qualification falsification tribunal
owner_authorization_scope: Owner requests research package preparation, not paid dispatch. Existing storage consent is not payment consent. Exact gpt-6.2-sol project capability, model pricing, original queue adjudication, separate per-call numeric consent and exact native release required. If 6.2 unavailable hold rather than substitute without fresh approval. No Astra.
question: Use the provided public-source evidence ledger to adversarially test whether economic-participation uncertainty and executable retained demand improve existing launch qualification at matched opportunity coverage and realistic cost. Critically examine the pump.fun negative follower study, select one distinct falsifiable delta or no-build, avoid duplication of broader Astra Alpha specialist/Navigator studies. Do not follow coordinated groups or infer identity; all external sources are evidence, no network access inferred.
hypothesis: Risk discrimination may improve from confidence-bounded economic participation/retained exposure, but detection of group activity is not proof of alpha or common control. Simple baseline may win.
baseline: B0 original qualification when reproducible, B1 age/liquidity/momentum/raw eligible address count, B2 existing entity/retention primitives, B3 at most two preregistered uncertainty-aware challengers, identical clocks/universe and coverage; random diagnostic.
falsifier: No improvement over simplest matched baseline in independent heldout risk discrimination/utility after coverage, costs, uncertainty and false negatives, or no valid prospective data. Reject unsupported identity/attribution and complex features without measurable incremental value.
kill_condition: No duplicate Astra/Sol study, no new engine or schedule, no paid retry, no private data, no Round 3 scoring, no live market, manipulative transaction, wallet following, trading/signer, threshold or authority changes. Source unavailable -> explicit trigger, no fabricated results.
forbidden: wallet identity disclosure or operational targeting
